title: Exhausted support draft retries must return a blocked result
answers: Why is a support ticket stuck on Processing?
How should a failed support draft finish?
What must stay in sync when changing draft retries?
body:
Symptom: A support ticket stays on Processing when the draft agent returns no usable draft or crashes.
Root cause: Raising on the final activity attempt prevents the workflow from recording a result, leaving the ticket in_progress; products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_give_up handles this boundary.
Fix pattern: Raise DraftNotProducedError while retries remain; on the final attempt return an empty reply with confidence 0 and verdict blocked_on_knowledge so the workflow can finish without auto-sending.
Constraints: Applies to missing or failed draft production; successful drafts retain their normal result. The current attempt limit is 2.
Invariant: _give_up and products/conversations/backend/temporal/pipeline.py:SupportReplyWorkflow must use products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/constants.py:DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS together; otherwise fallback timing can disagree with Temporal retry exhaustion.
applies: Support reply draft activity failures and changes to their Temporal retry policy.
